sub_limits_waiting_notes: Group policy combining personal accident, accidental hospitalisation, daily hospital cash and complementary benefits, primarily attached to motor / dealer programmes.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Accidental Hospitalization Cover when insured sustains accidental bodily injury while travelling in the named vehicle; reasonable and customary charges paid up to SI.

day_care_treatments.notes: Day care procedures included under Accidental Hospitalization Cover.

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance expenses included under accidental hospitalisation.

permanent_exclusions: War / nuclear / terrorism (subject to specific clause)
notable_exclusions_summary: Digit Complete Care is a group policy attached to motor / dealer programmes. Covers Personal Accident, Accidental Hospitalization, Daily Hospital Cash. Excludes illness-based hospitalisation, PED, cosmetic, hazardous sports.
claim_process_summary: 24x7 claim helpline 1800-258-4242; email healthclaims@godigit.com. Pre-authorisation via network or reimbursement.
